QF.id: XVI Clearing, Settlement and Risk Management_49

question.text: Delivery period margin at 20% on a contract worth Rs 45,00,000 would be:

explanation.text: The Logic: Delivery period margin = 20% x Rs 45,00,000 = Rs 9,00,000. The source workbook explains that delivery/tender margin is the higher of 3% plus the 5-day 99% VaR or 20%, and gives the same Rs 45,00,000 gold contract example with a Rs 9,00,000 delivery margin. The Trap: Rs 90,000 reflects a 2% rate, Rs 2,25,000 reflects the 5% initial margin level, and Rs 45,000 reflects a 1% rate. The delivery period margin is the highest of the margin types. Note: Distributor/cross-exam coaching labels replaced with neutral wording.
